decision_conditions: Insufficient and inadequate information has been submitted to enable the discharge of Condition 12 (Sustainable Drainage Strategy). The submitted details fail to demonstrate compliance with Policies CC3, DP3, F7, F8 and N2 of the NPPF (2026); Policies SI 5, SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021); Core Policies 21, 28 and 29 of the Core Strategy (2010); and Policies DMD 59, DMD 60, DMD 61 and DMD 62 of the Development Management Document (2014). The information submitted fails to adequately demonstrate compliance with the London Plan Drainage Hierarchy, provide sufficient details of all proposed SuDS features, or satisfactorily demonstrate exceedance routing and functionality, and accordingly the requirements of Condition 12 have not been met.
